name: caption-split-flap
title: Caption Split Flap
description: Every letter sits on its own flap tile and clatters through a few characters before landing the moment the word is spoken, like a station departure board.
useWhen: A launch, travel or tech video wants a mechanical, announcement-board feel: each word arrives as tiles flipping into place on cue.
The phrase should be readable as a board from the start: blank tiles hold the place of every upcoming word, so the layout never moves.
avoidWhen: You want letters to decode in place without tiles or a board look: use caption-scramble.
The captions sit over a busy talking head for a long video and should stay quiet: use caption-subtitle.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
